messages:
sanjay: Borealis pinged with an EAP request for their new tensor ASIC. NDA ok on their side but they want a light benchmark + telemetry handshake. targeting 4 weeks. thoughts?
marie: i'll run the NDA through legal. last hw NDA had an odd IP carveout, i want that scrubbed.
olivia: i'll own telemetry. propose minimal surface: CSV perf export + agent that POSTs anonymized metrics to our EAP endpoint. no raw prompts stored.
adam: for marketplace later we need an artifact spec (container/AMI) and metadata. mark that as non-blocking stretch goal. loop marketing (sara).
sanjay: Borealis asked specifically for: p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/sec, model cold-start time, kv-cache footprint, and crash logs. they also want a sync this week post-NDA.
sara: marketing note 12: hold announcements until bench results and a coop MOU. we can prep joint messaging but embargo until legal signoff.
partner_ops_bot: ACTION: created ticket EAP-804 (assignee: sanjay). sync scheduled in 72 hours.
marie: legal will aim NDA draft by EOD. adding a 45-day press embargo after bench completion; ok?
adam: 45 days fine. add marketplace privacy blurb for telemetry.
olivia: telemetry schema draft: tokens_per_sec, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, kv_cache_bytes, gpu_util_pct, oom_count, sampled_input_hash. transport: HTTPS POST to https://telemetry.redwood.ai/eap with X-EAP-HMAC. i'll share sample payload.
sanjay: sharing a tiny perf command for their infra:
```
python perf_run.py --model r-instruct-3b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 120 --report csv --kv-probe
```
please ensure --kv-probe is enabled to capture cache sizes.
marie: also flag SI work 12: Borealis wants Whitecap Systems to validate in a joint run. need contact intro and 2-week runway.
adam: added marketplace checklist to ticket: icon, short/long description, pricing bands, privacy & telemetry blurb, and PM contact.
olivia: i'll prepare a 50-prompt eval set focused on long-context quality regressions.
sanjay: timeline: week0 NDA + env exchange; week1 bench + telemetry; week2 infra fixes + SI prep; week3 SI joint test; week4 analysis + signoff; joint announcement earliest week6.
marie: require rollback clause in MOU for customer-impacting regressions.
sanjay: owners: NDA (marie) by Fri EOD; telemetry schema (olivia) by Tue; marketplace spec (adam + sara) by next Wed; bench script & runbook (sanjay) by Tue; SI intro (marie) by Mon.
partner_ops_bot: REMINDER: next sync in 72 hours.
